category_summary: **Bot Screen / Desktop Passthrough Launch (dominant story):** **@NousResearch** unveiled **[Bot Screen](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa)** in **Hermes Desktop**, live-streaming any bot session — browser driving, terminal typing, window use — to massive engagement (1958 likes, 394k views). Founder **@Teknium** followed with the interactive companion announcement: users can now [visually and interactively access the same machine](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) as their **Hermes Agent** via remote gateways (1141 likes, 173k views). Official documentation and a **@tonbistudio** [walkthrough video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d) (540 likes) round out the launch, and community hype ran hot — '[Finally!](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-014ad26a44c6)', '[Much needed!](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e)', '[Impressive!](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-015fe011793b)'. **Community OSS / oh-my-hermes Ecosystem:** Prioritized community author **@rlaope** had a prolific stretch, [open-sourcing **jeval**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-99948938337f) (JEV evaluation with visual result extraction) and shipping a [major **oh-my-hermes (OMH)** update](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8) adding **Jev-Skils**, model aliases, and routing across skills/models/agents/memory/**MCP** — signaling a fast-maturing [community plugin layer around **hermes-agent**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f). **Guides & Usage Tips:** **@Teknium** amplified **@tonbistudio**'s [guide video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9), and **@NousResearch** shared a practical tip: [run **Hermes via iMessage**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517) with whichever model you prefer. **Maintainer Engagement & Sentiment:** The overall mood is excitement plus confidence in responsiveness — **@Teknium** [pushed back on an unverified cache-bug claim](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec) with clear repro-issue guidance, [clarified a misattributed project](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21) as built by **NousResearch** rather than **Anthropic**, and [confirmed a same-day fix](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b) after user feedback. Sentiment skews strongly positive, with **@rlaope** also musing that [**Opus 5.5** is impressive but voicing hesitation on **Claude Code**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-797e0ee6c95e) — implicitly positioning **Hermes Agent** as the community alternative.
